title: Proximity-based super-resolution imaging enabled by DNA base-stacking interactions
authors: Banerjee A; Yadav S; Vidwath VS; Kalita S; Agasti S; Joshi H; Ganji M
one_liner_zh: 该文利用DNA碱基堆叠实现邻近检测的超分辨成像，并通过MD模拟探究机制，虽涉及DNA互作和物理模拟，但核心是成像技术而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Super-resolution imaging has gained significant traction in recent years due to its unprecedented ability to visualize target biomolecules at nanometer resolution. Here, we demonstrate the capability to detect target pairs that are in close proximity by exploiting base-stacking interactions between two DNA strands, each labelling one target. Our DNA probes hybridize transiently with the each other only when both target molecules are proximal, thus creating a hybridization site for fluorophore-conjugated DNA strand, called imager. In this design, hybridization and co-axial base-stacking act synergistically to enable imager binding, with stacking interactions providing essential stabilization that allows for transient hybridization. This synergy generates the stochastic binding events required for DNA-PAINT imaging, which we call Stack-Proximity-PAINT (Stack-pPAINT). To gain mechanistic insights into hybridization of our probe, we performed atomistic equilibrium and steered molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The simulations reveal that DNA base-stacking and fluorophore stacking together stabilize the imager. We utilized programmable DNA nanostructures to benchmark the applicability of Stack-pPAINT. As a cellular proof of concept, we visualized microtubular structures using Stack-pPAINT with antibodies targeting both alpha- and beta-tubulin molecules. This probe technology offers promising applications in cell biology research aimed at elucidating spatial interactomes at high resolution within cells.
abstract_zh: 近年来，超分辨成像因其前所未有的能力，能够以纳米级分辨率可视化目标生物分子而受到广泛关注。在此，我们展示了通过利用两条DNA链（每条标记一个目标）之间的碱基堆积相互作用，检测紧密邻近目标对的能力。我们的DNA探针仅在两个目标分子邻近时瞬时杂交，从而为荧光团偶联的DNA链（称为成像器）创建杂交位点。在该设计中，杂交和共轴碱基堆积协同作用，使成像器结合，其中堆积相互作用提供了必要的稳定性，允许瞬时杂交。这种协同作用产生了DNA-PAINT成像所需的随机结合事件，我们将其称为Stack-Proximity-PAINT（Stack-pPAINT）。为了深入了解我们探针杂交的机制，我们进行了原子级平衡和受控分子动力学（MD）模拟。模拟揭示，DNA碱基堆积和荧光团堆积共同稳定了成像器。我们利用可编程DNA纳米结构来基准测试Stack-pPAINT的适用性。作为细胞概念验证，我们使用针对α-和β-微管蛋白分子的抗体，通过Stack-pPAINT可视化了微管结构。该探针技术在旨在高分辨率阐明细胞内空间相互作用组的细胞生物学研究中，提供了有前景的应用。
